domainCanonicalizationEvidence.meaning: The Hong Kong host redirects HTTP to HTTPS and exposes the expected self-canonical URL. GitHub Pages previously served the full site on the apex; revision c244dcb replaced that duplicate output with 72 path-preserving redirect shells plus a dynamic 404, each using noindex, canonical and meta refresh, while preserving the domain-verification file. Live checks confirm the apex and www entry points now expose this client-side mitigation, but they still fail to arrive at the canonical origin by HTTP redirect: the apex returns 200, www leads to the HTTP apex, and HTTPS www downgrades to HTTP. Only 2 of 6 entry points are fully compliant; 4 are mitigated but remain noncompliant until Cloudflare returns a server-side 301 or 308 to https://hk.onyxdevslab.com/. GitHub Pages still reports https_enforced=false. Cloudflare configuration was not changed, and this mitigation does not prove search reprocessing, ranking improvement, AI citation, or recommendation.
